subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: Should this vLLM Usage-page report stay open while waiting for raw stream, transcript, Usage API, screenshot, and pricing evidence, or should maintainers treat the current streaming-usage implementation plus docs as sufficient?
rationale: Current source shows the intended usage pipeline, but the issue was filed against a release after the main vLLM streaming-usage fix and lacks artifacts that identify whether the remaining blank page is runtime, persistence, aggregation, UI, or pricing policy.

options.title: Keep waiting for evidence
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for redacted raw vLLM stream, transcript usage, `sessions.usage`, `usage.cost`, screenshot, and pricing config before authorizing code work.

options.title: Close as already covered
options.body: Close only if a maintainer accepts the current source/docs path as sufficient despite the missing live reproduction artifacts.

options.title: Route to pricing contract
options.body: Fold only the cost-calculation part into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 if new evidence shows tokens are present but cost is unknown.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting for evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for redacted raw vLLM stream, transcript usage, `sessions.usage`, `usage.cost`, screenshot, and pricing config before authorizing code work.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the vLLM streaming-usage fix and recent usage-cost behavior, so he is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding proof sufficiency or pricing policy.
